statements.text: Effective information (EI) is the mutual information between a maximum-entropy (uniform) distribution of interventions over all states of a system and the distribution of their effects one step later.
statements.scope: discrete causal models: logic gate networks, Markov chains, directed graphs

sources.quote: EI is also the mutual information (MI) between all possible causes and their effects, MI(UC;UE)
the idea is to calculate the mutual information I(X,Y) between a set of interventions (X) and their effects (Y)
